correctness.rationale: For each specified stub cycle, probability is 1/P_r(Q). It uses exactly two stubs at each participating vertex; therefore allowable leftover loop pairs decrease by sum_gamma(2d_v-3). Conditional residual matching gives E[LC_r]=(AB_r-S_r)/P_{r+1}(Q) when Q>=2r+2; E[L]=A/(Q-1), E[C_r]=B_r/P_r(Q). Subtraction gives displayed cov (2r A B_r/(Q-1)-S_r)/P_{r+1}. When Q=2r, the cycle exhausts all stubs, making mixed moment zero. Counting undirected vertex cycles (n)_r/(2r) and substituting regular degree d yields sign factor nd(2-d)+2d-3; fixed-r asymptotic coefficients follow dominant powers. Independent pairing enumeration by actual labeled half-edge matchings checked small graphs exactly. The model is not the uniform simple graph and r>=3 is essential.
residual_risks: Asymptotics require fixed d,r with n→infinity along valid nd parity, not r growing with n.
The r=2 double-edge case is excluded as prior work.
